usedFor: BigMailer holds your mailing contacts and Google Docs keeps the document that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes into.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in BigMailer, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new contact lands as text in a chosen tab, so you get a running record without copying anything.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's content, so choose add when you want a running list.
